headline: President Bush changes an earlier order that set up Volunteers for Prosperity, a program for skilled Americans volunteering abroad.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13317, which created the Volunteers for Prosperity program. That program encourages skilled American professionals to volunteer on U.S. development efforts in other countries. The title does not say what specific changes this order makes.

who_it_affects.group: Skilled American professionals who volunteer overseas
who_it_affects.how: They may be affected by changes to how the Volunteers for Prosperity program is run, though the specific changes are not described.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on international development
who_it_affects.how: They may have changed duties under the program, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 14, 2006; the effective date is not stated in the title.
